title: 4 links that explain today's biggest networking move: Tucows jumped24% on a deal. One-off or a rerating?
author: tickeron_community
selftext:
Networking and cloud split wide open today. Tucows jumped about 24%  
after agreeing to sell Ting, while Rubrik slid 5% in the software  
selloff. Applied Optoelectronics popped 7% premarket on a Reuters  
report before fading, and the average analyst target on Lumentum sits  
98% above the price. Here's today's rundown of the networking and  
cloud moves that actually stood out.  
  
Here is the rundown, drawn from today's write-ups.  
  
\*\*1. Tucows (TCX)\*\* — TCX jumped to $14.17 in Tuesday morning  
regular-session trading from Monday's close of $11.45, a gain of  
\+23.76% (+$2.72), after the news broke before the opening bell. The  
catalyst was a definitive agreement to sell Ting Holdco — Ting Fiber's  
owned fiber markets and their securitized financing facility — to  
Clearwave for nominal cash, removing roughly $301.5 million of  
principal securitized notes from...  
  
[https://tickeron.com/blogs/why-is-tucows-inc-tcx-stock-up-28-03-today-39868/](https://tickeron.com/blogs/why-is-tucows-inc-tcx-stock-up-28-03-today-39868/)  
  
\*\*2. Lumentum (LITE)\*\* — The central target of $1,080 is the  
arithmetic mean of roughly two dozen current analyst price targets,  
which span approximately $685 to $1,425. Target, not a promise.  
  
[https://tickeron.com/blogs/lumentum-holdings-lite-can-it-reach-1-080-98-upside-after-the-marvell-takeover-39464/](https://tickeron.com/blogs/lumentum-holdings-lite-can-it-reach-1-080-98-upside-after-the-marvell-takeover-39464/)  
  
\*\*3. Rubrik (RBRK)\*\* — Rubrik fell from Monday's $106.03 close to  
$100.30, a -5.40% decline, during Tuesday's regular session. The drop  
is sector-driven: high-multiple software and cybersecurity names slid  
as the AI-trade unwind deepened ahead of Nvidia's results after the  
close, with the 10-year Treasury yield holding above 5.1%.  
  
[https://tickeron.com/blogs/why-is-rubrik-inc-rbrk-stock-down-4-70-today-39878/](https://tickeron.com/blogs/why-is-rubrik-inc-rbrk-stock-down-4-70-today-39878/)  
  
\*\*4. Applied Optoelectronics (AAOI)\*\* — Applied Optoelectronics shares  
climbed from Monday's close of $45.16 to $46.31, a gain of +2.55%,  
during Tuesday's regular session, well off a premarket pop of roughly  
\+7% that faded at the open. The catalyst was a Reuters report  
published before the bell that the Trump administration will press  
ahead with restrictions on imports of new Chinese optical transceiver  
models, a policy that would shift share...  
  
[https://tickeron.com/blogs/why-is-applied-optoelectronics-aaoi-stock-up-2-10-today-39819/](https://tickeron.com/blogs/why-is-applied-optoelectronics-aaoi-stock-up-2-10-today-39819/)  
  
Is Tucows a one-day deal pop, or is something bigger happening in  
networking and cloud?  
  
Not financial advice. Figures are from today's (Nov 17) write-ups,  
using intraday or latest-close prices, not live quotes. Price targets  
are targets, not promises.
